command:
set -euo pipefail
WORK="$HOME/.cache/fred-omegacv1-go127-20260913"
TOOL="$HOME/.local/share/omegacv1-toolchains/go1.27.0"
rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK" "$(dirname "$TOOL")"
if [ ! -x "$TOOL/bin/go" ]; then
  TMP=$(mktemp -d)
  trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
  curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.27.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz -o "$TMP/go.tgz"
  rm -rf "$TOOL"
  mkdir -p "$TOOL"
  tar -xzf "$TMP/go.tgz" -C "$TMP"
  cp -a "$TMP/go/." "$TOOL/"
fi
export PATH="$TOOL/bin:$PATH"
printf 'FRED_HOST=%s\nFRED_USER=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(id -un)"
go version
git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1.git "$WORK/repo"
cd "$WORK/repo"
git checkout -q 2a6e2a98298b387271638db48650f5a97d0229eb
printf 'OMEGACV1_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
./scripts/validate-research-surface.sh
./scripts/materialize-harness.sh
cd build/current-harness
printf 'HARNESS_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
printf 'GO_MOD=%s\n' "$(grep '^go ' go.mod | head -1)"
go test ./...
printf 'FRED_GO_REGRESSION=PASS\n'
